messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High tail latency detected for /v1/chat/stream — p95=1.8s p99=6.2s (SLO: p95<=1s). Paging on-call: @amber_oncall :rotating_light:
amber_oncall: noticed, I'm paged — digging in now. What region/route?
incident-bot: Most errors/latency from prod-us-east route "chat-stream" and tokenizer preproc stage shows elevated durations in traces.
amber_oncall: pulling traces. @raj_sre can you look at infra scaling / queue depth?
raj_sre: on it. Looking at autoscaler logs: no pods in crashloop but queue backlog spiked from 20->240 reqs in 30s. NVidia GPU utilization 95% on pool-a.
kate_ml: I see long CPU spans inside prompt_preprocessor::expand_templates and tokenizer::tokenize_json_mode, median 350ms -> 1.2s per request on p99.
jun_runtime: Ah — JSON mode path has extra schema validation + heavy tool-schema rendering. A customer payload with very large tool schema was rolled out this morning (org: org_4287). Could be amplification.
beth_support: Customer-facing support notes: org_4287 reported slow replies at 10:32, multiple sessions stalled. They've got enterprise flow on dedicated capacity.
eli_product: Can we confirm customer is on Dedicated? If yes, routing decisions differ (no cross-org fallback unless allowed).
raj_sre: Confirmed — org_4287 on Dedicated pool 'ded-42' — pool is saturated. We're seeing tail requests hitting tokenizer loop causing streaming stalls — the stream handshake opens but tokens flush intermittently.
amber_oncall: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Disable JSON mode parsing for new requests from org_4287 (policy flag) 2) Scale up ded-42 by +2 nodes (if quota) 3) Add temp per-org concurrency limit to shed excess tail load
jun_runtime: Can push feature-flag to config: 
```
features.org_overrides.org_4287.json_mode=false
routing.dedicated_pools.ded-42.scale.desired=6
```
I'll prepare PR and run canary.
kate_ml: Also suggest patch to tokenizer: short-circuit tokenization when tool schema > 200KB to avoid worst-case O(n^2) path — will draft patch but not safe for immediate deploy.
raj_sre: Scaling now — started node API call. ETA ~3m to be ready.
incident-bot: Autoscaler events: +2 nodes accepted, new capacity expected 180s.
beth_support: Notifying customer that we are investigating and applying mitigations; will update in 15m.
amber_oncall: Implemented org override to disable JSON mode for org_4287. Observability: p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 1.1s within 60s, p99 still ~3.6s. Streaming stalls reduced but some long tails remain.
eli_product: Any customer-visible degradation counts as incident — opening postmortem and CC'ing account team.
jun_runtime: Pushed routing scale; pool capacity increased. I also added temporary fallback routing: if latency > 2s and pool saturated, route to smaller-quant model variant on shared pool (with customer opt-out) — enabled for org_4287 as emergency.
kate_ml: Quick investigation shows offending prompt templates included repeated tool schema expansions in prompt_builder -> expensive stringification; a small change to reuse pre-built schema blob would cut that cost. I'll prepare a patch.
raj_sre: Current numbers: p95=0.98s p99=2.4s for chat-stream overall after mitigations. Errors for streaming stall events dropped from 120/min -> 8/min.
amber_oncall: Handing off to @raj_sre for night shift monitoring. Key context: root cause = large tool schema + JSON-mode validation + tokenizer worst-case path + dedicated pool saturation. Mitigations applied: org_json_mode disabled, pool scaled +2, per-org concurrency cap, emergency fallback routing.
raj_sre: Ack, will monitor and follow up with postmortem. Recording runbook steps and customer impact estimate: affected requests ~3.2k over 25 minutes, impacted sessions ~140, SLO misses p95 for the window ~+420ms average.
beth_support: Sent update to org_4287: brief apology + mitigation summary. Customer asked for timeline to full fix.
eli_product: Prioritize tokenizer short-circuit + template reuse in next patch. Also consider enforcing size limits on tool schema at ingestion.
kate_ml: I'll create PR with template reuse and unit tests for JSON-mode path. Assigning to runtime for review.
amber_oncall: Closing active pager; leaving the thread open for postmortem notes. If any regressions occur, re-page. :white_check_mark:
